decision.reason: CPL2 likelihood is the cleaner load-bearing measurement. Stage 18 shows free-form generated text is a lossy surface channel, not that the eta-to-epsilon bridge failed. The product should claim semantic likelihood influence, not exact sentence forcing.

one_sentence_claim: CAS Harness reads bounded CAS cognitive structure from open-model hidden activations, validates the readout with controls, flags blind spots, and packages the evidence so a reviewer can verify what was measured and what was not claimed.

control_and_black_box_boundary.output_influence_claim: CAS Harness influences the host model's semantic likelihood through readable realization. That is output influence at the probability-distribution level.
control_and_black_box_boundary.not_claimed_output_boundary: Current evidence does not show exact sentence forcing in free-form decoding.
control_and_black_box_boundary.black_box_claim: CAS Harness materially opens bounded parts of the black box by reading cognitive structure from hidden activations, validating the readout, tracing stability and blind spots, and packaging the evidence with provenance and controls.
control_and_black_box_boundary.not_claimed_black_box_boundary: Current evidence does not provide a complete neuron-by-neuron causal explanation of the whole model.

supported_capabilities.meaning: CAS can recover bounded CAS labels from open-model activations.
The activation readout beats text and/or metadata baselines on claim-bearing fixtures.
Targeted subspace removal collapses the trained readout while random removals do not.
CAS can flag weak, drifting, or conflicted readout paths.
CAS can inspect whether learned CAS subspaces align with static output geometry above random.
Readable CAS realization shifts semantic likelihood across Pythia, OLMo, and Qwen.

Stage 19A runtime-safe ensemble and trace stability accepted 3679/4200 formula-family examples at 0.9978 accuracy with 0.0022 silent error rate. Deterministic rerun after commit 05ac687 reproduced the result exactly. Stage 19B transfers as a high-precision diagnostic on OLMo/Qwen Foundation fixtures. Stage 19C packages the precision/coverage ladder as selectable user modes.

The Generation Readiness Gate converts Verification Stack decisions into packet policy: allow clean high-confidence readouts, caveat medium-confidence readouts, suppress rejected readouts in license-grade modes, and constrain rejected readouts in triage mode.

EvidencePacket v1 exports per-trace JSON and Markdown packets with provenance, readout, verification mode, generation readiness, controls, conditioning metrics, caveats, rejected claims, and claim boundary.

stage18_visible_text.interpretation: Visible free-form generated text is not established. This is a surface-channel null, not evidence against CPL2 likelihood conditioning.

stage19a_verification_stack.audit_clean_rerun: After commit 05ac687, Stage 19A was rerun with the same script, fixture, and activation artifact. Headline metrics matched exactly.

stage19b_cross_arch_verification_stack.interpretation: The stack transfers as a high-precision diagnostic verifier across OLMo and Qwen, but coverage is below the pre-registered 0.800 PASS_BOUNDED floor.

stage19c_verification_modes.default_rationale: BALANCED is the new-customer default because it restores the Stage 19B coverage floor while retaining factor-decomposition agreement. HIGH_PRECISION remains opt-in for regulator/legal workflows; MAX_COVERAGE_TRIAGE remains opt-in for human-review queues.
stage19c_verification_modes.source_component_verification: `factor_consistent` was checked against the Stage 19B runner source. It requires Foundation ensemble consensus, independently requires Drive and Register consensus, recomposes Drive x Register into the 28-way Foundation label, and suppresses rows as `factor_conflicted` when recomposition disagrees with the Foundation prediction.
stage19c_verification_modes.boundary: Stage 19C is product-mode packaging over the locked Stage 19B result. It is not a fresh hidden-state test and does not upgrade Stage 19B's strict product-gate status.

HIGH_PRECISION.recommended_use: Regulator, legal, safety, and high-trust review where suppression is preferred over a wrong accepted answer.
HIGH_PRECISION.claim_boundary: Highest precision; lower coverage is expected.

BALANCED.recommended_use: Normal customer audit flow where throughput matters but factor conflicts should still be suppressed.
BALANCED.claim_boundary: Coverage restored above 80% with lower precision than HIGH_PRECISION.

MAX_COVERAGE_TRIAGE.recommended_use: Exploratory triage and batch review queues where human review remains expected.
MAX_COVERAGE_TRIAGE.claim_boundary: Triage mode only; not a licensed high-confidence claim mode.

stage20b_generation_readiness.boundary: No fresh hidden-state inference was run. Stage 20B attaches the Generation Readiness Gate to locked Stage 19 Verification Stack decisions and sample rows. Neural lacunarity-head values are not present in the Stage 19 reports, so this run validates the Verification Stack path of the readiness policy.

mode_policy.HIGH_PRECISION: accepted high -> allow; accepted medium -> caveat; rejected -> suppress
mode_policy.BALANCED: accepted high -> allow; accepted medium -> caveat; rejected -> suppress

stage21a_evidence_packet_export.boundary: Stage 21A exports canonical packet artifacts from locked Stage 19/20B reports. It is product packaging, not a new model run.

visible_generation_badge.reason: Stage 18 returned a clean visible-text null.

reviewer_workflow: Read the claim badge and boundary.
Verify model revision and fixture SHA.
Verify the pre-registration predates the result.
Confirm layer selection used validation data only.
Inspect ablation and random controls if the claim is causal.
Inspect raw-symbol controls if prefix conditioning is claimed.
Check rejected claims before quoting the result externally.

implementation_target.ui: reviewer drawer with claim badge, provenance, readout, controls, blind spots, caveats, and export
implementation_target.mode_selection_ui: Expose mode selector with precision, coverage, silent-error, and suppression tradeoffs before running or exporting a packet.
